meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 命令行工具的安装状态,找出过期、走样或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 Codex 安装后行为异常,想确认本地环境是否需要更新或修复
copy.tagline_en: Health-check your Codex CLI install and flag stale, drifted, or broken setups
copy.fit_line_en: For you if Codex acts up after an install or update and you want your local setup audited

howto.what: Claude 会检查你本地的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装,与最新源码逐项比对,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上命令输出或文件作证据。它只做诊断,不改动你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你要求做 doctor 或健康检查、提到 LazyCodex 等关键词,或 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常、你怀疑安装已损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一次 LazyCodex doctor 健康检查
say.note: 输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告并附证据

say.text: Codex 更新后行为怪怪的,帮我诊断一下
say.note: 比对本地安装与最新源码找漂移

say.text: 检查我的 Codex 版本够不够新,能不能用 gpt-6-astra
say.note: 按 0.153.1 门槛判定 Astra 就绪

howto.what_en: Claude inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install, compares it against the latest sources, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report where every verdict cites its evidence. Diagnosis only: it won't modify your install, config, or repos.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, or see Codex behave oddly after an install, update, or config change, or suspect a stale or broken setup.

say_en.text: Run a LazyCodex doctor health check for me.
say_en.note: Returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence

say_en.text: Codex acted weird after an update — please diagnose it.
say_en.note: Compares local install against latest sources

say_en.text: Is my Codex new enough to use gpt-6-astra?
say_en.note: Checks the 0.153.1 floor for Astra readiness
